_law: THE MAP THE HEAD STOPPED BEING ABLE TO HOLD (owner 2026-08-22: 'project ใหญ่เกินกว่าที่ตรวจเช็คได้ว่าขั้นไหนผิดอะไรแล้วใช่ไหม' -> advice -> 'ลุย', ORD-2026-08-22-front-door-dims). One row per check the render lanes actually run, classified by (1) STAGE — where in the pipe it fires, and (2) COMPARES — what it holds the work against: a = our own spec/derivation/history (self-consistency), b = the client's sheet / the target / the delivered anchor pool, c = a WORLD standard independent of both, d = process-state (registers, orders, ledgers). The first full census (2026-08-22, 5-agent sweep) found 28 rungs: a=9 b=4 c=3 d=12, with ONE blocking world-standard check on the render path — which is the measured answer to why 'the bed is too small' had no asker. ADMISSION of new rows is governed by D-112 (a new instrument must give eyes to a none_yet critic-debt class, replace a proven liar, or be owner-ordered — printed in the gate that introduces it; enforcement is discipline in gate artifacts, NOT a new checker, by D-112's own words). The defect-class half of the map is qa/critic-debt.json's none_yet rows — this file does not duplicate them. plan_status prints this map's summary at every session open; a map nobody prints is the queue-with-no-consumer defect wearing a map.
